summary: Support GitHub issue templates when creating issues

architecture.decision: Resolve configured GitHub issue templates relative to project_dir in IntegrationConfig and render inline, Markdown frontmatter, and YAML issue forms in GitHubBackend.create_ticket while preserving the single delimited managed-description section and exact title readback.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; template rendering is opt-in via integrations.github.issue_template.

delivery.outcome: Support configured integrations.github.issue_template rendering when creating GitHub issues while keeping round-trip managed-description updates intact.

validation.evidence: All template loading, frontmatter, YAML form, and security negative tests pass.
Managed description markers and readback round-trip tests pass.
